Terms and conditions

Last updated: 18 November 2026. Also read our privacy notice.

Who sells to you

Week2Speak is a service run by Mei Gabriela Parrablanco, a sole trader in the United Kingdom. Contact: hello@week2speak.com.

What the 7-Day Sprint includes

Full access to the website during your Sprint (Speech Mode, games, shadowing, the course and the guided Sprint), two 25-minute 1-to-1 calls with your tutor, and WhatsApp contact with her during your week. It does not include written corrections or extra classes.

Price and payment

The price is the one shown when you book, depending on your country, and includes any applicable taxes. Payment is made with Stripe; we never see or store your card details. Places are limited and are given in order of payment.

The calls

You book the time. If you need to change it, let us know at least 24 hours before. If you miss a call without notice, it counts as done. If your tutor has to move it, she offers you another time.

Cancellation and refunds

You have 14 days from payment to cancel. If you cancel before your first call with the tutor, we refund the full amount. Because the Sprint starts within those 14 days at your request when you book, if you cancel after the first call we refund the amount minus the part of the service you have already received (calls taken and Sprint days with full access). After 14 days, or once the Sprint is over, there is no refund. The outcome of the Sprint (for example, whether you manage to speak for two minutes) depends on your practice and does not give a right to a refund. To cancel, email hello@week2speak.com or message Mei on WhatsApp.

Your account

Your account is personal: do not share it. Use real details and a strong password. You can delete it whenever you like from your account page. Free accounts have daily usage limits, which may change.

Using the website

Week2Speak's content (text, audio, 3D characters and design) is ours or used with permission. You may use it to learn, not to copy or resell it. Do not use the website to harass anyone or to get around its limits.

Liability

We do our best to keep the website working well, but there may be outages or errors. Nothing in these terms limits your statutory rights as a consumer.

Changes and governing law

If we change these terms, the new version applies to new purchases. They are governed by the law of England and Wales, without prejudice to the consumer-protection rules of your country.
